zh.title: 美航 A319 通報液壓異常返航鳳凰城
zh.summary: 美國航空 AA3230 航班起飛後通報液壓異常，返抵鳳凰城。旅客改搭另一架 A319 抵達波特蘭。
body: 《The Aviation Herald》報導，美國航空一架空中巴士 A319 於11月19日執飛鳳凰城往波特蘭的 AA3230 航班。機組起飛後通報液壓異常，停止爬升並返回鳳凰城天港國際機場。涉事飛機註冊號為 N703UW。
飛機落地後，塔臺回報現場冒煙。機場緊急應變人員檢查後，飛機自行滑回停機坪。報導指出，航空公司調派另一架 A319 接手航班，較原定時間晚約4個半小時抵達波特蘭。
這架飛機約在落地40小時後恢復載客。液壓異常的原因仍待確認。

en.title: American Airlines A319 returns to Phoenix after crew reports hydraulic problem
en.summary: American Airlines Flight AA3230 returned to Phoenix after its crew reported a hydraulic problem. A replacement A319 continued to Portland.
body: The Aviation Herald reported that American Airlines Flight AA3230 took off for Portland on November 19. The crew stopped the climb after reporting a hydraulic problem and returned to Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport. The Airbus A319 was registered N703UW.

The tower reported smoke after touchdown. Airport emergency responders inspected the aircraft, which then taxied to the apron. American dispatched a replacement A319 that reached Portland about four and a half hours behind schedule.
The aircraft returned to service about 40 hours after landing. The cause of the reported hydraulic problem remains unconfirmed.

facts.claim: AA3230 returned to Phoenix after a reported hydraulic problem.
A replacement A319 reached Portland about 4.5 hours late.
